tools.name: ransack
tools.description: Search, fetch, and research the live web. Modes: search, fetch, discover, hosts (7 keyless sources), shop, verify, help. format=markdown|json|hybrid. Every result is tagged with the engine that found it. Run mode='help' for the full manual (parameters, limits, error codes, data caveats) before guess

tools.name: youtube
tools.description: Retrieve the transcript from a YouTube video URL or 11-character video ID (not a keyword search). start/end (seconds or mm:ss) keep only that window of a long transcript. Summaries and chapters are not offered. Limits: 120/min. See ransack(mode='help').

tools.name: tasks_get
tools.description: Retrieve the status and result of an asynchronous task started by ransack(mode='fetch', background=true). Limits: 120/min. Error -32029 = rate limited, wait retry_after_s. See ransack(mode='help').

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Retrieve a persisted research report and its citation map by report_id (legacy: reports produced before the research lane was retired 2026-09-20). Limits: 120/min. See ransack(mode='help').

tools.name: search_memory
tools.description: Query the semantic index of prior fetched web content (pages, articles, transcripts). NOT conversational history: it recalls indexed content by meaning and keywords, not your past queries. Limits: 120/min. See ransack(mode='help').

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the live web. Thin alias of ransack(mode='search') for hosts that require tools literally named search and fetch (ChatGPT Deep Research); results carry the engine that found each one. Run ransack(mode='help') for the full manual.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return its readable content. Thin alias of ransack(mode='fetch') for hosts that require tools literally named search and fetch (ChatGPT Deep Research). Run ransack(mode='help') for the full manual.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
